cautions.zh: “长度变化”是几何：作用线（起点到止点的直线，股四头肌经髌骨）在当前姿势下的长度与静止姿势相比。它不说明肌肉是否在用力。
cautions.en: "Length change" is geometry: the length of the line of action (a straight line from origin to insertion; the quadriceps through the patella) in this pose against the rest pose. It does not say whether the muscle is working.

cautions.zh: “负荷”是估计：静力优化（最小化激活度平方和）给出的、抵抗重力保持这个姿势所需的肌肉激活度。它不是肌电图，也不是测量值。
cautions.en: "Load" is an estimate: the activations that static optimisation (least sum of squared activations) needs to hold this pose against gravity. It is neither an EMG nor a measurement.

cautions.zh: 简化：静止不动（没有惯性）；只有重力和可选的手持重物；没有协同收缩（真人为了稳定关节会让拮抗肌一起用力）；没有韧带和关节囊的被动力，只有关节到达活动范围极限时算作被动承担。
cautions.en: Simplifications: static (no inertia); gravity and an optional hand-held load only; no co-contraction (people co-activate antagonists to stabilise joints); no passive force of ligaments or capsules, except that a joint at the end of its range is taken to be held passively.

cautions.zh: 作用线是直线，不绕过骨和关节：三角肌、臀大肌、髂腰肌、屈膝较深时的股四头肌、手和足的长肌腱都因此不可靠，列表里带 ⚠。力臂与参照模型不符的肌肉同样带 ⚠。
cautions.en: Lines of action are straight and do not wrap round bone or joints: the deltoid, gluteus maximus, iliopsoas, the quadriceps in deeper knee flexion and the long tendons of hand and foot are unreliable for that reason and carry ⚠ in the list, as do muscles whose moment arms disagree with the reference models.

cautions.zh: 最大肌力 = PCSA × 比张力（61 N/cm²，假设）；PCSA = 我们的肌肉体积 / 纤维长度；246 / 332 条肌肉的纤维长度用的是默认比例（假设）。激活度的绝对值因此不可信，可以看的是谁在用力、谁没有。
cautions.en: Maximum force = PCSA × specific tension (61 N/cm², an assumption); PCSA = our muscle volume / fibre length; 246 of 332 muscles use the default fibre-length ratio (an assumption). Absolute activations are therefore not to be trusted; what can be read is which muscles work and which do not.

cautions.zh: 172 个肌肉部件没有作用线，不参与计算（多裂肌、腹内斜肌等）；它们跨过的关节上的力矩会由别的肌肉或残差承担。
cautions.en: 172 muscle parts have no line of action and take no part (multifidus, internal oblique and others); torque at the joints they span falls to other muscles or to the residual.

cautions.zh: 节段质量由皮肤围出的体积乘以区域平均密度得到，再归一化到 BMI × 身高²；改变体型时所有节段按同一比例变重。站立时两脚的受力按足底接触点分配，重心投影落在支撑面外时会注明。
cautions.en: Segment masses are the volume enclosed by the skin times a regional mean density, normalised to BMI × stature²; changing body shape scales every segment alike. When standing, load is shared between the sole contact points, and a centre of mass outside the support is stated.
